correctness.rationale: Derivation of q2 via T3 is exact. Entry formula (1) follows from A^2 and graph degrees, and positivity of q2(A) diagonal from the residual interval bound. For any edge of a ≤11-vertex tree, embedding the incident double star and testing its monic characteristic cubic at 2(s+2)/3 proves lambda_max > 2(s+2)/3, uniformly. Exact D5,5 spectrum and 1/4-shift witness prove the n=12 failure and the full symmetric-double-star threshold. The packaged SymPy verifier confirms the polynomial and radical identities; 435 unlabelled tree computations are supplementary, not the proof.

value.rationale: The smallest forbidden tree identifies a sharp boundary in coordinatewise monotonicity of finite Chebyshev inverse approximations of shifted Laplacians, despite their spectral positive definiteness. The exact graph-local criterion and symmetric-double-star shift threshold give direct practical diagnostics and a tiny regression matrix. The valued fact is the global tree cutoff and proof, not the already-known Chebyshev expansion.
